scope: Dead-owner temporary-file recovery test, not a crash-proof privacy guarantee

test.recoveryCase: Real short-lived child PID exits; marked directory removed, current-parent directory retained, unmarked directory retained, malformed PID retained, second recovery is idempotent

recoveryPolicy: On runtime status/new inference, remove only owned UUID directories with a valid marker whose parent process is confirmed absent. Live, unmarked, malformed or ambiguous owners are retained.
limitations: Abrupt OS termination can leave plaintext SDK capture files until next runtime startup/recovery.

Previous unmarked synthetic orphan directories cannot be automatically attributed; two authorized literal-path removal attempts were rejected by automatic approval review as blocked by policy. No alternate-tool deletion attempted.
